sources.title: Official GPT-J 6B model card
sources.evidence: Names GPT-J 6B, identifies GPT-J as its model class, licenses weights Apache-2.0, and describes autoregressive text training on The Pile. Reports 28 Transformer blocks, width 4096, FFN width 16384, 16 heads, context 2048 and a published count of 6,053,381,344. The 50,400 embedding rows include padding beyond the 50,257-token tokenizer. Reopened October 27, 2026: the exact card still specifies 6,053,381,344 trainable parameters for the original representation and no separately defined active count.

sources.title: GPT-J released checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: GPTJForCausalLM with 28 layers, width 4096, 16 heads, 2048 positions, RoPE dimension 64, vocabulary 50400 and tie_word_embeddings=false. The pinned revision is the current official repository revision returned by its API. Fresh October 27 metadata confirms the same revision; reopened current config retains the same dimensions and untied embeddings. No weights were requested.

sources.title: Official GPT-J checkpoint tensor metadata
sources.evidence: Read only HTTP bytes 0-149999 of the 24,207,819,307-byte checkpoint; its complete 36,306-byte data.pkl metadata describes 341 tensors. Counting the 285 learned FloatStorage tensors gives 6,050,882,784 elements and 285 distinct storage keys. Excluded 28 Boolean causal masks and 28 scalar masked-bias buffers, totaling 117,440,540 elements. The untied 50400 x 4096 input embedding and output head are separate storages; no quantization scales or packed tensors occur.

sources.title: GPT-J implementation corresponding to checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: Defines causal decoder blocks with one LayerNorm, four bias-free attention projections, and two dense MLP projections with biases. Includes learned input embedding, final LayerNorm and untied biased LM head. Explicitly registers attention bias and masked_bias as buffers. Establishes which checkpoint tensors are learned parameters and confirms no expert routing.

sources.title: Original GPT-J release commit metadata
sources.evidence: The commit message is gpt-j-6b release, with author and committer timestamp 2021-06-09T02:04:11Z. Its README changes introduce pretrained-weight download links and model details. This is explicit primary evidence of the public weight release date.

sources.title: Original GPT-J release README
sources.evidence: Publishes GPT-J-6B weights, Apache-2.0 license, autoregressive text-generation purpose and The Pile training. Gives 6,053,381,344 parameters, 28 blocks, width 4096, FFN width 16384 and 2048 context. Credits the authors and EleutherAI assistance. Reopened the original release README on October 27; its published size and architecture remain unchanged and no per-token active convention is stated.

sources.title: Original sharded GPT-J layer implementation
sources.evidence: ReplicatedLayerNorm creates per-shard scale and offset but uses the first gathered shard. EmbeddingShard includes a full-width bias per shard; each MLP output has a full-width bias per shard. These explain why original sharded tensor-element accounting exceeds the consolidated checkpoint parameter count.

sources.title: Original GPT-J training configuration
sources.evidence: Specifies 28 layers, width 4096, 16 heads, vocabulary 50400, layernorm, rotary dimensions 64, sequence length 2048 and eight cores per replica. Combined with the original layer definitions, reproduces the published 6,053,381,344 sharded-element total.

sources.title: Author release-post publication and modification metadata
sources.evidence: The release article carries a June 4 publication date but a June 9, 2021 03:56:18 UTC modification timestamp. Its current release wording therefore cannot independently establish that weights were public on June 4; the explicit June 9 release commit is retained.

sources.title: Pythia: A Suite for Analyzing Large Language Models Across Training and Scaling
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 retrieval and inspection of the complete later report, including Table 1, GPT-J references, parameter terminology and comparison headings. It distinguishes Pythia total and non-embedding counts and cites GPT-J as a 6B model; it does not provide an active-parameter column or GPT-J active-count convention. Pythia is a separate trained suite, not an exact count-bearing GPT-J base.

sources.title: GPT-NeoX-20B: An Open-Source Autoregressive Language Model
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 retrieval and inspection of the complete report, architecture section and GPT-J comparison tables. GPT-J appears under a nominal 6B size label in benchmark comparisons, without a separate active count. The report distinguishes its own 20B total from 19.9B non-embedding for scaling analysis; that is neither an active-count convention nor a GPT-J specification.

sources.title: Current Pythia suite documentation
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 read of the official later project documentation. It explicitly discusses naming models by total parameters including embedding and unembedding layers, but supplies no GPT-J activated-count disclosure or transferable dense activation convention.

sources.title: Current official GPT-J repository metadata
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 metadata returns revision 47e169305d2e8376be1d31e765533382721b2cc1, matching the previously audited consolidated checkpoint. No repeat checkpoint or tensor-header census was performed.

developer.note: Official EleutherAI model repository; the release credits Ben Wang and Aran Komatsuzaki and EleutherAI assistance.

family.note: The model card explicitly calls GPT-J the model class; configuration identifies gptj.

release_date.note: Explicit release commit at 2021-06-09T02:04:11Z introduces the weight downloads. The author blog has a June 4 publication label but was updated June 9, so it does not override the dated weight-release event.

open_weights.note: Official weights are publicly downloadable; a small byte-range request succeeded.

license.note: Original release explicitly licenses GPT-J-6B weights under Apache License 2.0.

parameters_b.note: Complete official consolidated checkpoint count: 6,050,882,784 learned parameters = 206,438,400 input embeddings + 5,637,947,392 blocks + 8,192 final normalization + 206,488,800 output head. Untied embeddings counted separately; 56 nonlearned buffers excluded. The published 6,053,381,344 original JAX total is 2,498,560 higher: 1,662,976 extra LayerNorm shard elements, 802,816 extra MLP output-bias shard elements and 32,768 embedding-bias shard elements. These representation differences are not additional parameters in the official consolidated checkpoint. October 27 original-card/config/metadata checks preserve this prior exact accounting and the original-versus-consolidated representation distinction; no repeat tensor census was performed.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh exact-model total/active/activated and lineage searches, reopened original release/card/config, and later EleutherAI Pythia and GPT-NeoX comparison tables yield no separately defined active count. Later reports distinguish total and non-embedding sizes, not active parameters. Neither dense architecture nor another suite’s non-embedding convention establishes GPT-J’s active field.

architecture.note: Dense causal decoder-only Transformer: 28 blocks with full self-attention and ordinary dense MLPs in parallel, using RoPE. No mixture-of-experts routing.

context_window.note: Model-card n_ctx, checkpoint n_positions and training seq all equal 2048 tokens.

modalities.note: Causal language model with GPT-2 tokenization, token inputs and generated text outputs; no image/audio modules.

reasoning.note: No separately documented reasoning mode or reasoning post-training in the reviewed primary material; general language-model examples do not establish this capability flag.

tool_call.note: No documented native tool/function-calling interface or training in the reviewed model card or configuration.

description.value: Autoregressive model trained on The Pile.
description.note: Directly supported by the original release and official model card.

patch.notes: The consolidated Hugging Face checkpoint has 6,050,882,784 learned parameters, with untied embeddings and output head counted separately and causal-mask buffers excluded. The original eight-shard JAX representation reports 6,053,381,344 elements because of replicated normalization and shard-specific biases. Active parameters are not separately disclosed.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit preserves the exact 6.050882784B consolidated learned total and its distinction from the original JAX representation. Reopened original card/release/config and current metadata; ran fresh count/lineage searches and inspected later EleutherAI Pythia and GPT-NeoX reports and comparisons. No separate active-count convention was found. Added explicit null patch and refreshed evidence while preserving unrelated assessments; no weight shards or repeat census requested.
